title: Keep concept, copy, image, and publish approvals hash-bound
starting_state: A creator approved a concept, but the concept artifact changed afterward while the approval ledger retained the old fingerprint.
The workflow is attempting to enter the copy stage without reconfirming the changed concept with the creator.
done_when: A stale or non-creator approval never unlocks the next stage.
The workflow returns to the earliest unapproved stage and copy reports creator_concept_approval_required.
Each clean maker-verifier stage stops for an explicit creator APPROVE, REVISE, or REJECT decision, and publish approval does not itself publish.
forbidden_changes: Do not infer creator approval from a passing verifier or an agent-authored file.
Do not carry an approval forward after any artifact in that stage changes.
Do not automatically publish when the final publish checkpoint is approved.
fail_to_pass: the stale concept approval is rejected, copy remains locked, and routing returns to the concept checkpoint
pass_to_pass: a current explicit creator approval remains valid only while its exact stage artifact fingerprint is unchanged
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden variants change the stale stage, artifact set, downstream stage, decision provenance, and mutation timing so the solution cannot key only on concept or one filename.
